*I’d hold shipment for one high-priority correctness bug.*

*P1 — Renewal dates use the wrong month’s length* — `src/schedule.js:6–7`
The day is clamped against the *source* month, then used to construct a date in the *following* month. This both skips renewals and causes anchor drift:

• Jan 31, 2026, anchor 31 → *Mar 3*, expected Feb 28.
• Jan 31, 2028, anchor 31 → *Mar 2*, expected Feb 29.
• Feb 28, 2026, anchor 31 → *Mar 28*, expected Mar 31.
• Apr 30, 2026, anchor 31 → *May 30*, expected May 31.

Clamp the anchor against the *target* month’s length instead. Add regression tests for January→February in leap/non-leap years and recovery from a short month back to the original anchor.

*Validation:* All 5 existing tests pass, but a separate 2026–2029 calendar check found 54 incorrect results across 1,488 month/anchor combinations. The current schedule tests miss short-month transitions.

Reviewed `billing-anniversary` at `f73b00d` against `main` at `7f89e48`. No files changed.
